findings.description: Three distinct legal entities share the name SmartStar Technology but are separate companies in different jurisdictions with different directors
UK SmartStar Technology Ltd was dissolved via compulsory strike-off on October 7, 2025, for non-compliance with statutory returns
SmartJobs is a legitimate B2B job management and site health & safety software platform operated by the NZ entity
No fraud reports, scam complaints, or regulatory warnings found for any SmartStar Technology entity across 10+ databases
The UK entity had an unusually high declared share capital of 10M GBP for a company at a virtual office address
No cryptocurrency indicators, Telegram presence, or advertising campaigns found for any entity
The UK entity and NZ entity have different directors (Rojs Gordons vs Rex Huang) and should not be merged

conclusion: NO FRAUD ESTABLISHED - Evidence does not support the allegation. The target appears to be a legitimate software company. The UK entity dissolution was due to administrative non-compliance, not fraud.
